title: Transfer applications replay original QR files, reflection adapters and FTP file types
description: Prepare full original Maven modules and use real application receivers and inputs. Read a QR file through ImageIO and decode it, generate a real constructor adapter, and classify an actual file, folder and missing path through the VFS client and a loopback Apache FTPServer. The server libraries are those declared by the original project tests. Both releases see identical fixtures.
expected: All three cases record their qualified observation or precise unresolved step, including original old expectation and actual method entry.

steps.run: export TMPDIR="$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/tmp"; python3 lib/benchmark/external-upgrades/baselines/complete_client.py --repositories "$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/agent-tmp/0cea9d0e-0fe8-427e-8e71-96614b084e11/external-upgrade-engineering/repos.json" --preparations "$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/agent-tmp/0cea9d0e-0fe8-427e-8e71-96614b084e11/external-upgrade-engineering/transfer-complete" --maven-cache "$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/agent-tmp/0cea9d0e-0fe8-427e-8e71-96614b084e11/external-upgrade-shared-maven/repository" --output verification/external-upgrades/corpus-runs/transfer-modules/01 --case compsuite-i-37 --case reflector-35 --case commons-vfs-55c96cfd
